hero_headline.name: hero_headline
hero_headline.default: 'Generator service, priced upfront. Book it in two minutes.'

hero_sub.name: hero_sub
hero_sub.default: 'See the price, pick an arrival window and check out. No phone tag, no waiting for a callback.'

call_needed.name: call_needed
call_needed.default:
'A charged phone, or a charger nearby. Video uses more battery than normal.
Good signal or Wi-Fi where your equipment is. Garages and the side of the house are often weak spots.
A clear path to your electrical panel, your gas or propane meter, and where the generator would go. Unlock any gates.'

call_recommended.name: call_recommended
call_recommended.default:
'A tape measure.
A sheet of printer paper and some tape. We''ll ask you to tape it flat where we need to measure.
Your property survey or site plan, if you have one. You can add a photo of it on your visit page before the call.
A flashlight, if your electrical panel is in a dark spot.
A second person to hold the phone, if that''s easier.
Know whether you have natural gas or propane, and where the meter or tank is.'
